errors.symptom: Failed to establish softphone connection
errors.detail: The browser cannot open media to TurnNlb on UDP 3478.
errors.fix: Allow outbound UDP 3478 to TurnNlb-*.elb.region.amazonaws.com and retest with the Endpoint Connectivity tool.

errors.symptom: ice_collection_timeout
errors.detail: ICE candidate collection timed out, so the CCP never built a media channel.
errors.fix: Check DNS, UDP 3478, and whether a VPN or proxy is hairpinning media.

errors.symptom: One-way audio
errors.detail: Signaling works and RTP or WebRTC media does not, often because of NAT or a stateless firewall.
errors.fix: Allow the browser ephemeral range on a stateless firewall. Avoid VPN for media.

errors.symptom: Lambda AccessDenied in the flow log
errors.detail: The function is not associated with the instance, or the resource policy does not allow connect.amazonaws.com.
errors.fix: Add the function to the instance and grant lambda:InvokeFunction to connect.amazonaws.com.

errors.symptom: Lambda runs 10 seconds and the flow takes Error
errors.detail: Synchronous invoke waits at most 8 seconds even if the function timeout is 15.
errors.fix: Return faster, or use asynchronous mode and a Wait block. A sequence of Lambda calls must stay within 20 seconds.

errors.symptom: Response is not a string map
errors.detail: The function returned nested JSON while the block expects a flat string map, or the payload exceeds 32 KB.
errors.fix: Match the block response validation. Keep values to the characters Connect accepts.

errors.symptom: You've reached the limit of Phone Numbers
errors.detail: Can appear on the first claim. The default quota is 10, but new accounts still need Support for some telephony limits.
errors.fix: Open a Support case. Do not keep retrying the claim.

errors.symptom: Fast busy on a campaign call
errors.detail: Concurrent campaign active calls default to 0.
errors.fix: Request a quota increase before the campaign start.

errors.symptom: Chat API quota exceeded while agents look idle
errors.detail: Idle chats still count against the 500 concurrent chat quota.
errors.fix: Use persistent chat where it fits, and alarm on concurrent chats.

errors.symptom: Recording missing from S3
errors.detail: Bucket policy, KMS key policy, or the flow never enabled recording.
errors.fix: Check the Set recording block, the storage config, and the key policy for the Connect service.

errors.symptom: CTR not in the bucket after one minute
errors.detail: Firehose buffers. Five quiet minutes is the documented point to start worrying.
errors.fix: Check the delivery stream errors and the S3 prefix.

errors.symptom: SAML user has no routing profile
errors.detail: The assertion did not map a routing profile, security profile, or role the instance accepts.
errors.fix: Map the attributes your identity provider sends. Test with one user before a cutover.

errors.symptom: Flow error with no customer-facing branch
errors.detail: An error output is disconnected, so Connect terminates the contact.
errors.fix: Connect every error, timeout, and default branch. Turn on flow logs first.

errors.symptom: Transfer to queue does nothing useful
errors.detail: Set working queue was skipped, or it sits after the transfer.
errors.fix: Set the queue, then transfer. In a customer queue flow, Transfer to queue moves an already queued contact.

errors.symptom: Agents in the wrong queue receive the contact
errors.detail: The routing profile priority and delay, not the queue name alone, decide eligibility.
errors.fix: Lower number is higher priority. Delay holds the contact away from a profile until the timer expires.

errors.symptom: Global Resiliency replica missing numbers
errors.detail: Numbers must be in a traffic distribution group. In Tokyo, only numbers enabled for Global Resiliency fully replicate to Osaka, and Osaka delivery can take up to 20 seconds.
errors.fix: Associate numbers before the failover test. Treat Osaka as a replica Region.

errors.symptom: Custom CCP loads and audio never starts
errors.detail: Streams can run media-less. Media still needs the softphone allow list.
errors.fix: Init the CCP with softphone options and test UDP 3478.

errors.symptom: Error rate above 2 percent after a domain allow list
errors.detail: Option 1 can fail when a proxy cannot resolve the WebSocket or TURN domains.
errors.fix: Test more than 200 calls. If the error rate stays above 2 percent, review proxy resolution or use the IP-range option.

errors.symptom: Email thread split into a new contact
errors.detail: Replies after 90 days start a new thread. Active email contacts expire at 14 days unless you set connect:ContactExpiry, and never beyond 90.
errors.fix: Set the expiry attribute deliberately.

errors.symptom: Voice ID block still in a flow after May 2026
errors.detail: Support ended 20 May 2026. New customers stopped 20 May 2025.
errors.fix: Remove Set Voice ID and Check Voice ID. Use a partner or a one-time password via End User Messaging SMS.

faults.fix: Return inside 8 seconds, or switch the block to asynchronous and play a prompt.
